source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Uses traditional plumb-line reading for uncertain anak, explicitly noted rather than claimed certain.
Preserves the question-answer sequence and distinction LORD/Lord.
Keeps Isaac's uncommon spelling/name and dynasty rather than king alone.
Keeps accusation as Amaziah's report, not narrator's judgment.
Preserves the report's king/dynasty difference from v9 instead of harmonizing quotations.
Chooses past tense in context but notes Hebrew verbless present alternative and guild sense of son.
Retains the full family catastrophe and ritual uncleanness without attributing voluntary choice to the wife.
